Rebalancing Cpunanospersecond - Average CPU nanoseconds spent on processing replica operations in the last 30 minutes.
Successes

MMA Overloaded Store Lease Grace Success - Number of overloaded stores in the lease shedding grace period (first 2 min of overload) where at least one lease or replica was successfully moved away during this store's MMA rebalancing pass.

MMA Overloaded Store Short Dur Success - Number of stores overloaded for a short duration (2-5 min) where at least one lease or replica was successfully moved away during this store's MMA rebalancing pass.

MMA Overloaded Store Medium Dur Success - Number of stores overloaded for a medium duration (5-8 min) where at least one lease or replica was successfully moved away during this store's MMA rebalancing pass.

MMA Overloaded Store Long Dur Success - Number of stores overloaded for a long duration (8+ min) where at least one lease or replica was successfully moved away during this store's MMA rebalancing pass.
Failures

MMA Overloaded Store Lease Grace Failure - Number of overloaded stores in the lease shedding grace period (first 2 min of overload) where all shedding attempts failed during this store's MMA rebalancing pass.
MMA Overloaded Store Short Dur Failure - Number of stores overloaded for a short duration (2-5 min) where all shedding attempts failed during this store's MMA rebalancing pass.
MMA Overloaded Store Medium Dur Failure - Number of stores overloaded for a medium duration (5-8 min) where all shedding attempts failed during this store's MMA rebalancing pass.
MMA Overloaded Store Long Dur Failure - Number of stores overloaded for a long duration (8+ min) where all shedding attempts failed during this store's MMA rebalancing pass.
MMA actions
MMA Change Rebalance Lease Success - Number of MMA-initiated lease transfers (moving the leaseholder to balance load) that completed successfully.
MMA Change Rebalance Replica Success - Number of MMA-initiated replica changes (adding, removing, or moving replicas to balance load) that completed successfully.
MMA Change Rebalance Lease Failure - Number of MMA-initiated lease transfers (moving the leaseholder to balance load) that failed.
MMA Change Rebalance Replica Failure - Number of MMA-initiated replica changes (adding, removing, or moving replicas to balance load) that failed.
External actions
MMA Change External Lease Success - Number of external lease transfers (moving the leaseholder to a different replica, not initiated by MMA) that completed successfully.
MMA Change External Replica Success - Number of external replica changes (adding, removing, or moving replicas not initiated by MMA) that completed successfully.

MMA External Registration Success - Number of external operations (replica/lease changes not initiated by MMA, e.g., from admin commands or other allocators) that were successfully registered with MMA.
MMA Change External Lease Failure - Number of external lease transfers (moving the leaseholder to a different replica, not initiated by MMA) that failed.
MMA Change External Replica Failure - Number of external replica changes (adding, removing, or moving replicas not initiated by MMA) that failed.

MMA External Registration Failure - Number of external operations (replica/lease changes not initiated by MMA) that failed to register with MMA due to pre-check failures (e.g., the change conflicts with MMA's current state).
